ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface exceeding 95% of total fluke area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming high-contrast ratios in limited segments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast focal white spots and annular rings distributed non-contiguously across both lobes; no large contiguous geometric blobs; pigmentation is essentially solid black with discrete white interruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entirety of the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 2-10 pixels in depth, creating a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast white annular pixel clusters (circular rings) measuring between 5-15 pixels in diameter, distributed across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several prominent high-contrast white linear streaks; notable diagonal mark crossing the lower quadrant of the left lobe and intersecting marks on the right lobe medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (consistent with parasitic attachment) and intersecting white rake marks; high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated heavily at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness and white pigmentation at the extreme distal points of the trailing edge, contrasting sharply against the primarily dark dorsal background.
